scenario.description: Patient asks about pending lab results.
scenario.goal: Directed to portal or nurse callback appropriately.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Are my blood test results back?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Results are released through the patient portal. I can send a portal reset link or have a nurse call you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Request sent, expect a call by end of day.
